en.sayed-ali-raza: I swear to you by Allāh
that you should not be that Imām of the people who will be killed
because it has been said that, “An Imām of this people will be killed after which killing and fighting will be made open for them till the Day of Judgement,
and he will confuse their matters and spread troubles over them.
As a result, they will not discern truth from wrong. They will oscillate like waves and would be utterly misled.”
You should not behave as the carrying beast for Marwān so that he may drag you wherever he likes, despite (your) seniority of age and length of life.
